title: Deletion–contraction for spanning trees
statement:
Let $G$ be a finite graph, and write $\tau(G)$ for its number of spanning trees, that is, the number of tree subgraphs of $G$ on the full vertex set. If $e$ is an edge of $G$, then
\[
\tau(G) = \tau(G - e) + \tau(G \cdot e),
\]
where $G - e$ is the graph obtained by deleting $e$ and $G \cdot e$ is the graph obtained by contracting $e$ (deleting it and identifying its two ends).
hypotheses_covered: e is an edge of G (e ∈ G.edgeSet)
replaced:
(deletion--contraction). \emph{If \texttt{e} is a link of \texttt{G}, then
\texttt{$\tau$(G) = $\tau$(G - e) + $\tau$(G $\cdot$ e)}.}
